title: ThinkSafe: Self-Generated Safety Alignment for Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.23143v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance through reinforcement learning but can suffer safety degradation. External teacher distillation can restore safety yet may compromise reasoning performance. We formalize safety realignment as a KL projection: the student's native filter-accepted distribution is uniquely KL-optimal, while teacher targets incur excess KL when they differ. Guided by this analysis, we propose ThinkSafe, which generates safety-alignment data from the frozen student without external teachers. Refusal steering elicits safety reasoning, and a safety guard filters the responses before offline fine-tuning. Our analysis bounds steering-induced target distortion and gives a sufficient condition for lower average target KL than teacher distillation. Experiments on DeepSeek-R1-Distill and Qwen3 show substantial safety improvements with competitive reasoning performance. On Qwen3-0.6B, ThinkSafe achieves better safe

translated_title: ThinkSafe：面向推理模型的自生成安全对齐
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型通过强化学习取得了强大的性能，但可能出现安全性退化。外部教师模型蒸馏可以恢复安全性，却可能损害推理性能。我们将安全重新对齐形式化为KL投影问题：学生模型自身被过滤器接受的原生分布在KL散度意义上是唯一最优的，而教师目标在与之存在差异时会产生额外的KL散度。基于这一分析，我们提出了ThinkSafe，它在无需外部教师的情况下，从冻结的学生模型自身生成安全对齐数据。该方法通过拒绝引导引出安全推理，再由安全护栏对响应进行过滤，最后进行离线微调。我们的分析界定了引导所引起的目标失真，并给出了比教师蒸馏取得更低平均目标KL散度的充分条件。在DeepSeek-R1-Distill和Qwen3上的实验表明，该方法在保持有竞争力的推理性能的同时，实现了显著的安全性提升。在Qwen3-0.6B上，ThinkSafe取得了更好的安全表现
tldr: 提出ThinkSafe方法，无需外部教师模型，通过拒绝引导从冻结的推理模型自身生成安全对齐数据并进行离线微调，理论上可证明其目标KL散度低于教师蒸馏，在DeepSeek-R1-Distill和Qwen3上实现了显著的安全提升且推理性能不受损。
en_tdlr: ThinkSafe generates safety-alignment data from the frozen reasoning model itself via refusal steering without external teachers, provably achieving lower target KL than teacher distillation, and delivers substantial safety improvements with competitive reasoning performance on DeepSeek-R1-Distill and Qwen3.
